title: Seed Sterilization Protocol
author: Alex Rajewski
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x59fq96

steps.title: Set up sterilization chamber
steps.instruction: Prepare a container (such as a dessication chamber) in a fume hood to hold the seeds and the gas-generating reagents.

substeps.instruction: Place a petri dish of seeds in the chamber with the lid halfway on.
Place a 100mL beaker containing approximately 50 mL of bleach in the chamber next to the petri dish.

steps.title: Prepare HCl reagent
steps.instruction: Prepare approximately 3 mL of HCl in a transfer pipet or similar device.

steps.title: Generate sterilizing gas
steps.instruction: Rapidly react the HCl and bleach to produce gas and seal the chamber to prevent gas escape.

substeps.instruction: Hold the chamber lid in one hand.
Squirt the HCl into the beaker of bleach.
Quickly close the chamber to seal in the gas.

steps.title: Incubate seeds
steps.instruction: Allow the seeds to be sterilized in the sealed chamber for approximately 3 hours.

substeps.instruction: Note: This duration is suitable for tomato, tobacco, and Arabidopsis seeds.

steps.title: Recover and store seeds
steps.instruction: Remove the seeds from the gas environment and seal them for storage or use.

substeps.instruction: Slide the petri dish lid completely on to seal the seeds.
Store seeds as is for several weeks or transfer to a laminar flow hood.

steps.title: Clean up and disposal
steps.instruction: Safely clear the chamber and dispose of chemical waste.

substeps.instruction: Allow the chamber to air out for approximately one hour.
Dispose of the beaker contents (salt water/acidic solution) according to local regulations.
